patch_description: This version uses a more regime-aware feature set built around short rolling windows, rolling z-scores, and explicit change-in-market-character signals. Instead of leaning on long-horizon absolute levels that tend to break across regime shifts, it emphasizes normalized short-term momentum, volatility change, efficiency change, and momentum×regime interactions. The XGBoost configuration is also made less over-regularized so the model can retain more slope on validation without collapsing toward the mean. Feature count is kept under the 80-feature cap, and all features use only past data.
